nodes.name: ComfyUI-GGUF
nodes.why: Loads GGUF diffusion models and text encoders. Required by the GGUF variants of the image and video modules.

nodes.name: ComfyUI-Manager
nodes.why: Recommended for updates, snapshots and a clean restart. ComfyUI 0.30+ ships it as a Python package, so the audit checks site-packages as well as the legacy custom_nodes folder.
